That notice is for the next batch — but checkout is still live on three variants: Standard Antenna (US) at $985.83, and the Standard + Bonus Antenna for EU/NZ or CA/LATAM/AU at $1,225.83. The U. bonus-antenna one is the only one sold out.

Taking names is just the Notify me when Live button on the page — your email, nothing else.

Where are you shipping to?
whats teh bonus antenna

Honestly, the listing doesn't spell it out — it's a second antenna bundled per region, and it's what takes the price from $985.83 to $1,225.83. Every variant already includes the 1090 MHz antenna, cables, mast clamps and plug.

Want me to get the exact spec on the bonus one from the team?
how about install manual

The page gives the install shape: antenna outside on a rooftop mast or in the attic with clear sky view, the red sensor box indoors, ethernet or WiFi to it. Mast clamps and cables are in the box.

The actual manual I won't link from memory — I've asked the team for that and the bonus antenna spec together.

Where's it going, US or elsewhere? That decides which variant you'd buy.
what is teh power draw

Not listed on the page, and I won't quote a figure I can't confirm. It's a small always-on receiver box, nothing like a miner's draw, but the exact watts I've added to what the team is coming back with.

Anything else you want them to cover while they're writing it?
how high above the roof line must teh antanne sit

There's no required height on the listing — the rule it gives is clear line of sight to the sky. 1090 MHz is line-of-sight, so above the ridge beats below it, and an attic still works with less range.

I've put the mast-height guidance on the list for the team too. What's your install spot, roof or attic?
how doe srang impact pay out

Straight answer: there's no payout to model yet. 4DSKY is on testnet — you earn $4DSKY points, no token and no launch date announced. The founder has said USDC rewards to operators are coming, but nothing is live.

More sky means more aircraft seen, so more points. How points convert later, nobody can promise you.
so eventually the more tracking that can be done will pay out more

That's the logic, and it's how most DePIN networks score: unique coverage others can't provide counts most. A spot with sky nobody else is watching is worth more than another receiver in a crowded city.

But it's points on a testnet with no token, so I can't promise points become money. Buy it because you want the sensor up and a spot in the next phase.
what is the next batch mean ?

It means a future shipment of units from the manufacturer. When current stock runs out, the page switches to Notify me and the next batch email goes to that list first. No date announced for it.

Which is why the three live variants matter — those you can buy today rather than wait on the list.

this is the language from either the standard or standard with bonus antannae: Update, September 2026. Sales are closed while we take names for the next batch. 4DSKY is still on testnet: you earn points, there is no token and no launch date.

You're right, and that line sits on the product description, so it shows on every variant. The live inventory disagrees with it: three variants still have working checkout.

I'd rather the team confirm which is current than have you buy and get cancelled. Adding it to what they're answering now.
